query: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request_metadata_event_receipts WHERE event_id = $1 AND request_id = $2 AND (event_sha256 IS NULL OR event_sha256 = $3) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM usage_facts WHERE id = $1 AND request_id = $2 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM attempt_usage_facts WHERE event_id = $1 AND request_id = $2 ) AS "value!"
